pending.title: #TSLA STILL NEEDS A CLOSE ABOVE $349.59 TO GO HIGHER #Tesla #daytrading
pending.description:
Please ❤️like and 🔁share with fellow Tesla traders/investors

#Tesla closed yesterday at $345.82, below the key pivot level.

With the broader market potentially getting a lift following $NVDA earnings, #TSLA could get another chance to challenge the key $349.59 pivot today.

But the technical setup remains very clear: it needs a CLOSE above $349.59 to turn the near-term picture bullish.

*

The larger bearish structure is still intact.

About five weeks ago, TSLA closed below the $382.73 bottom of its 18-month rising channel, triggering a major sell signal with a 3–5 month objective of $228.24.

A countertrend rebound was expected from the initial decline, potentially carrying the stock back toward $382.73.

But that rally has now suffered another setback after Wednesday’s close below $349.59, the bottom of a four-week rising channel.

*

That makes $349.59 the critical bull/bear line.

If TSLA can close back above $349.59, the latest sell signal could turn into a false breakdown.

In that scenario, the trade flips bullish, with $362.86 as the first upside objective and then a narrowing resistance zone around $375.53–$382.73 by the end of next week.

A successful reversal could therefore put $382.73 within reach over the next 1–2 weeks.

*

However, even a rally back toward $383 would not necessarily invalidate the larger bearish thesis.

The $375.53–$382.73 area is part of a broader long-term resistance structure extending toward $416.03. 

That zone could contain buying through the remainder of the year before the longer-term decline potentially resumes toward the $220s.

*

If TSLA remains below $349.59, downside remains the path of least resistance.

The first target is $340.10. A close below there could produce a relatively quick move toward $323.78 over the following 2–3 trading days.

Because $TSLA has already settled below $349.59, $328.78 is also considered likely by the end of next week unless the stock reverses the signal.

*

More importantly, remaining below $349.59 keeps a larger 2–3 week target around $291.81 active.

That level has technical confluence from both a wave-count projection and a descending channel bottom, making the low $290s the key intermediate downside objective.

*

So the setup is unusually binary:
– Close above $349.59 → reverse bullish, with $362.86 first and $375.53–$382.73 potentially next
– Remain below $349.59 → $340.10, $328.78/$323.78, and ultimately a potential retest of $291.81

*

For now, $349.59 is the level that decides the next swing. 

TSLA doesn’t simply need to trade above it intraday. It needs to close above it to put the higher targets back in play.

*

pending.title: #TSLA CLEARED THE TRIGGER — $363 NEXT, THEN $383? #Tesla #daytrading
pending.description:
Please ❤️like and 🔁share with fellow Tesla traders/investors

#Tesla closed yesterday at $354.81, successfully clearing the $349.59 level we were watching. So, the near-term setup has strengthened — but there are still several important levels ahead.

*

The key development was the rejection of what initially looked like a classic sell signal.

#TSLA had closed below its channel bottom around $352.22, only to reverse the next day, reclaim the level and close above the prior day’s high.

That failed breakdown is itself a sign of strength and supports bullish continuation over the next couple of weeks.

*

The critical near-term pivot is now $345.82. As long as TSLA continues to settle above $345.82, the upside remains favored.

The next major test is $362.86, the highest settlement price from roughly a week ago.

This level could contain intraday or even daily highs, but a close above $362.86 would be significant. If that happens, $TSLA could be only 3–5 trading days away from testing the narrowing $377.79–$382.73 resistance zone.

That’s where things get much more interesting.

*

Despite the improving short-term picture, $382.73 remains major long-term sellable resistance.

TSLA broke below this larger formation five weeks ago, establishing $228.24 as a realistic 3–5 month downside objective. So for now, the rally from the low $290s is still technically counter-trend.

*

If TSLA reaches $377.79–$382.73 in the next couple of weeks, that area could potentially mark a significant top and offer a new short setup.

However, a close above $382.73 would change the intermediate picture again, opening the door to $416.03 within another week or two.

And $416.03 is the really important longer-term level.

A close above $416.03 would generate a major buy signal through the remainder of the year and into Q1, potentially setting up a move into the $550s over the following 3–5 months.

*

On the downside, keep watching $345.82.

A close back below that level would flip the near-term setup bearish and generate a 3–5 day target around $323.78.

That level could produce a bounce, but over a 2–3 week timeframe, the low $290s could come back into play.

*

So the roadmap is increasingly clear:
– Above $345.82 keeps the near-term rally alive. $362.86 is the next breakout test.
– Above $362.86 puts $377.79–$382.73 within reach.
– Above $382.73 opens $416.03.
– Above $416.03 would represent the major structural bullish breakout.

*

For now, $TSLA has cleared yesterday’s trigger and strengthened the near-term bull case.

The next question is whether it can take out $363 and make the run toward $383.

*
